subject: Ill tell you....
author: PsychedelicBabe
body:
😏What makes me feel like im addicted....?......well where do i begin??....My name is PsychedelicBabe and i am addicted to Burnout Revenge.....ive been playing this game for 3 years now and there hasnt been 1 day in them years that i havent either played revenge or watched my b/f play......so when people ask me are you addicted my answer usually is well yeah?......but how do you get addicted?......for me its the power ...... the adrenalin ....... and that feeling of nausea that you get when you pass the line with someone 1 second behind you ....... if you had asked me 3 weeks ago you would have got a really boring answer.....but as i havent raced or been able to race for 3 weeks i now know im addicted.......instead of waking up and playing revenge i was cleaning.....wtf.....i felt like a part of me was missing......then came the sweats im not messing i felt like a recovering crack head it was awful.....id lie in bed of a night and all i could see where the tracks......BANG.....i knew i was addicted and i knew i had to feed this addiction.......no matter what......when i had my first race yesterday my heart was thumping and my blood was rushing......i hadnt had that true adrenalin of Revenge in a long long time and did it feel good?...... IT FELT ABSOLUTELY AMAZING.........Addiction is weird alot of people associate it to drugs,alcholol or other stimulants so when you ask them are they addicted to a certain game they say ''NO'' but you take that game away and then there answer will suddenly change to ''YES I AM ADDICTED''....... ❤️

subject: Muppets is a show
author: SUFFUR
body:
You Like Revenge great, like Paradsie, great. You like the Burnout Games great, the Welcome mat is on the floor.

I Like Pardise, now we have the complete game as it were, and the timed challenges are fun, got some number one times with mates.

Ranked racing still sucks unless you have a good connection, as well as the host and everyone else.

Criterion saying it's this internet that is the problem, is a bit lame, they worked for the others, but Paradise is different, they say, well why make a game that can't work until Internet 2?

The other online modes are great too, but you need a good host to run them, keeping everyone near by is the best way, run a challenge, then run MM/SR and RR. And it works. And fun!

I have got into racing for challenges, and crashing less now, which is good.

For noobs to Paradise use the Rai-jin, learn to drive, then use boost cars😛, on-line mind, lol. If your that bad, use the Hunter Olympus, serious noob mobile.

The controls are different to all the other games, IMO, so you have to start from scratch, learning new stuff.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?

I do have a review in mind for Cagney, and will write it some time? It has improved the game, and if this was in the box from day one, I think more of the old skoolers would have played it? And maybe stuck around?

But it has become a broken record, with the same moans and groans, play it or don't, but move on, if you don't like or care. Meaning if you see a topic about Paradise, don't look, and if you look, don't write anything, what has been written before, again, and again, is the same, just like going around an old track again and again, boring and just a waste of time.

Not that Cagney is perfect, but I have more fun on Paradise now, unless we have a noob in the room, then it can be a bit frustrating, but they will get there, eventually after the 5th or 6th try, lol.

And people play Revenge because a bug/glitch makes it more fun, yes skill, to get the technique down, but if you can play Paradise without crashing every 10 minutes that takes skill, and there are people out there that do that all the time and way past 10 minutes.

With all Burnout games it's about skill and a lot of luck, and luck is all about how you can react to a situation, and with skill over time you get great driving/playing, and luck happens when needed😉.

Play it, don't play it, but if you don't like it avoid the topic, as it will only have a bit of squirell shyte in every bite.
